response.original_title: Easy-Guide How to Add Another Room to Your Norwegian Cruise Line booking
response.overview: To add an extra room to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line reservation, call Norwegian Cruise Line at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada)  or +44-289-708-0062(UK) or contact your travel advisor, as new cabins cannot be added to an existing booking online. Reach out directly by phone. If you booked through a travel agent or the Norwegian Vacation Club, your agent must make the changes for you. To add an additional room to an existing Norwegian Cruise Line reservation, you must book a separate new stateroom and link it to your current itinerary by calling Norwegian Cruise Line +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada)  or your travel agent. You cannot directly add an extra physical stateroom onto an existing reservation online. You can book a separate stateroom online or have an agent do it. Contact Norwegian Cruise Line directly at +1-866-254-7549 (US/Canada)  (or your original travel agent) to ensure the new room is properly linked to your current booking.
